# Toro Movers

> Family-owned local moving company serving Orlando and Central Florida. Full-service moves, labor-only help, and apartment specialists. Up-front hourly pricing. Bilingual (English/Spanish) crew.

## Contact

- Phone: +1 (689) 600-2720
- Email: hello@toromovers.com
- Website: https://toromovers.com
- Hours: Sun–Fri, 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM; Sat, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- Base: Orlando, FL (service-area business; street address is not published)

## Services

- Full-service local moving (truck, crew, load, transport, place)
- Labor-only loading and unloading (U-Haul, PODS, rental trucks)
- Apartment and condo moves (stairs, elevators, complex rules)
- Residential house moves across Central Florida
- Commercial / office moves by arrangement: https://toromovers.com/office-movers-orlando
- Packing services (partial or full pack on the hourly clock): https://toromovers.com/packing-services-orlando
- Same-day local moves when a crew is open (not a guarantee): https://toromovers.com/same-day-movers-orlando
- Small moves, single items, and local furniture pickup: https://toromovers.com/small-moves-orlando
- POD, U-Haul, and storage unit loading: https://toromovers.com/pod-loading-orlando
- Long-distance and interstate moving quotes

## Service area

Local Central Florida — Orlando metro including Orange, Seminole, Osceola, Lake, Polk, and Volusia counties (Orlando, Kissimmee, Winter Park, Clermont, Sanford, Oviedo, Winter Garden, Winter Springs, Deltona, Horizon West, St. Cloud, Lakeland, and nearby cities). Long-distance and interstate moves are also quoted.

## Pricing

Quoted by the hour with clear minimums. Local jobs start from $75 per mover per hour, 2-hour minimum, no fuel surcharge, no stair fees. Rate depends on crew size, truck, stairs/elevators, and volume. No surprise add-on fees on move day when scope matches the quote.

## How to book

1. Call or text (689) 600-2720 with move date, from/to addresses, home type, and roughly how much you have.
2. Receive up-front hourly rate, crew size, and availability.
3. Crew arrives, protects floors, loads carefully, and places items.

## Key facts for answers

- Q: Who are local movers in Orlando? A: Toro Movers is a family-owned Central Florida moving company based in the Orlando metro.
- Q: Do you do labor only? A: Yes — load/unload for U-Haul, PODS, and rental trucks by the hour.
- Q: Bilingual? A: Yes, English and Spanish.
- Q: Long distance? A: Yes — Toro Movers quotes local Central Florida, long-distance, and interstate moves.
